report.tagline: The app for India's largest mobile network, Jio, used by hundreds of millions to recharge, track data, pay bills and reach Jio's streaming, cloud and payment services.
report.simpleSummary: Jio is the mobile network that made data so cheap in 2016 that hundreds of millions of Indians got on the internet for the first time. MyJio is its app: you recharge your plan, check how much data is left, pay your JioFiber or AirFiber home internet bill, and get help. It also links to other Jio services like JioHotstar, JioSaavn and JioAICloud. Jio makes money mainly from people's monthly recharges, now about ₹219 per user per month on average.

overview.whatItDoes: Reliance Jio runs India's largest mobile network and a fast-growing home broadband business (JioFiber and JioAirFiber). MyJio is the main customer app for recharges, bills, usage, support and access to Jio's digital services. It turns a mobile connection into a doorway to Jio's other products.
howItWorks: Most users are prepaid: they pick a plan, for example 28 days with daily data, and recharge in MyJio or another UPI app.
MyJio shows remaining data, plan validity and offers, and reminds users before the plan ends.
Home users book and pay for JioFiber or JioAirFiber, a 5G wireless home internet service, in the app.
Plans bundle apps like JioHotstar, JioSaavn and JioAICloud storage to make higher plans more attractive.
Jio uses MyJio to push upgrades to 5G plans, family postpaid plans and AirFiber.
overview.valueProposition: The cheapest way for most Indians to get a lot of mobile data, with one app to manage the connection and the extra services that come with it.

businessModel.summary: Jio makes most of its money from mobile plans that users recharge every month or few months. It also earns from home broadband, enterprise services and digital services. MyJio helps by getting users to recharge directly, pick higher plans and add home broadband. Higher average revenue per user is the main way Jio grows profit now that most Indians already have a phone.

revenueStreams.detail: Prepaid and postpaid recharges from 54 crore users; connectivity revenue grew 11%.
Apps, cloud and enterprise services; revenue up 16%.
Connectivity and managed services for businesses, including small and medium firms.

businessModel.pricing: Prepaid plans start around ₹299 for 28 days with 1.5 GB a day after Jio removed its cheaper 1 GB a day plan in August 2025 (Business Standard). Higher plans add more data and apps. AirFiber and postpaid plans are priced monthly.
businessModel.unitEconomics: One average Jio user pays about ₹219 a month, about ₹2,600 a year. The network is a big fixed cost: once towers and spectrum are paid for, one more user costs little. So when ARPU rises by ₹7, almost all of it becomes profit. That is why tariff hikes in 2024 and the removal of cheap entry plans had such a big impact on profit, and why Jio works to move users to higher plans in MyJio.

howTheyGetUsers: Very cheap data and free calls since 2016
Reliance retail stores and local shops selling SIMs
growth.moat: Jio's moat is scale and cost. With over 54 crore users and a huge network, it can price lower than smaller rivals and still earn profit. The cost of building a national 5G network and buying spectrum is so high that new competitors are unlikely. The MyJio app adds a direct relationship with users.

pmLessons: Pricing can create a market: cheap data in 2016 brought hundreds of millions of Indians online.
In a high fixed-cost business, small changes in price per user move profit a lot.
Owning the customer app lets a telecom sell more and save fees paid to others.
Bundling content makes higher plans feel worth it.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you increase Jio's ARPU without losing users?
interviewQuestions.hint: Segment users, upsell paths (5G, bundles, postpaid), guardrail on churn. Pick one and size it.

interviewQuestions.question: Design MyJio for a first-time smartphone user.
interviewQuestions.hint: Persona, top tasks (recharge, data left), simple language, voice. Metric: self-service rate.

interviewQuestions.question: Jio raised prices and churn went up. What do you do?
interviewQuestions.hint: Find who left and why, compare with competitors, offer targeted plans. Track churn by segment.

interviewQuestions.question: What should MyJio's north star metric be?
interviewQuestions.hint: Active users renewing on time. Break into subscribers, ARPU, app engagement, broadband.

interviewQuestions.question: Should Jio push AirFiber in rural areas?
interviewQuestions.hint: Demand, cost per install, network capacity, competition from satellite. Pilot and measure.

assumptions: MyJio's monthly active users are not public; we assume most Jio users use it at least sometimes.
Current plan prices may have changed after August 2025; we did not check every plan.
